dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid and continuous geometric narrowing from the maximum lateral width at the mid-body toward an acute point at the visible posterior limit.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are predominantly smooth and symmetrical; no significant asymmetrical bulges or indentations are detectable against the water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median reflectance across the dorsal surface with minimal tonal variation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of fine, low-contrast linear markings and superficial scratches distributed across the anterior and central dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: The dorsal ridge is visible as a sharp longitudinal shadow-casting line; no traumatic topological depressions or unnatural geometric deformations are present.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple fine, superficial linear scars and intersecting rake marks are visible on the dorsal surface, primarily oriented longitudinally.
